principles.principle: be overly delusional with your life.
you can become paralyzed if you overanalyze.
principles.body: overthinking kills more opportunities than rejection ever will.

principles.principle: life is meant to be messy.
some areas require order, others require chaos.
there is no shame in changing your mind. reach back out to that friend. try again. life is too short for regret.
allow people to change & allow your perception to change about them too.
principles.body: one of my own principles that i've been quoting SOOO often! anticipate a new Substack about this soon!
